_why: Every flow that erp_compliance.py --all MUST audit. Without this, --all audits whatever happens to be in this directory and reports 'all N flows comply' on a subset - which is exactly how WF-E and WF-B went four days with no circuit breaker deployed while --all stayed green. A missing export is now a FAILURE that names the flow, not silence.
_how: Export with get_workflow_details and write the .workflow object to exports/<slug>.json. Matching is on the workflow id, not the filename.

_hand: audited_by_hand records a manual audit where no export exists yet. It is NOT a substitute for one: only an export lets --all re-check the flow when the canonical breaker or a rule changes, which is how drift is caught. Where a line names a graph fixture under tools/offline/fixtures/, erp_compliance.py has actually been run - against a hand-transcribed graph, so it proves the checker's verdict on the flow as described, not that the deployment matches. tools/offline/fixture_mutation_test.py keeps those fixtures honest.
